test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Find the odd one out from the given alternatives:
solution:
Look at the given options:

 
• Sardar Patel – Indian freedom fighter
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru – Indian freedom fighter and first Prime Minister
 
• Subhash Bose – Indian freedom fighter
 
• Ratan Tata – Industrialist/businessman

Odd one : All except Ratan Tata were freedom fighters.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
